title: Memorizon: Training World Models Beyond Their Context Window

beats.text: How can an AI recall a spot it saw just now without using up all its energy on each tiny, small, fast image?
beats.visual_focus: A camera moving through a long corridor with flickering memory fragments.

visual_blueprint.title: THE MEMORY PARADOX
visual_blueprint.sub: Comparing long-span vision vs compute constraints

motif_params.sub: Comparing long-span vision vs compute constraints

beats.text: Think of a library where you do not read each book, you just pick key notes from a shared desk for your big task.
beats.visual_focus: A bustling library with cards floating from shelves into a central index desk.

visual_blueprint.title: INDEXED RETRIEVAL
visual_blueprint.sub: Accessing memory without reading full sequence

motif_params.title: INDEXED RETRIEVAL
motif_params.sub: Accessing memory without reading full sequence

beats.text: We teach the bot to hold just the last few parts, making a small stack of key shots from each path it takes.
beats.visual_focus: A stream of video frames being condensed into tiny, glowing data squares.

visual_blueprint.title: SNAPSHOT CONDENSATION
visual_blueprint.sub: Merging long timelines into sparse storage

motif_params.title: SNAPSHOT CONDENSATION
motif_params.sub: Merging long timelines into sparse storage

beats.text: The bot uses views to link these parts, like a sculptor who wipes off the clay to keep only the main, strong form.
beats.visual_focus: Light rays connecting two distant points in a 3D scene, discarding surrounding haze.

beats.text: Now, the bot stays sharp for a long time. It keeps things clear while the cost stays low for any length of trip.
beats.visual_focus: A cost graph showing a sharp spike for old methods and a flat line for the new model.
